title: Curve Dental to Launch Integrated Phone System, Curve Voice
html:
Curve Voice simplifies front-office work and helps practices deliver a more personal patient experience with integrated calling, texting, call analytics, and 24/7 coverage.

Curve Dental® recently announced the upcoming launch of Curve Voice, a dental office phone system that works natively within Curve’s all-in-one practice management software. Many practices still use standalone phone systems that operate separately from patient records and practice workflows, creating duplicate work, incomplete context, and missed follow-up opportunities. Curve Voice closes that gap by connecting calls, voicemail, texting, and analytics with the patient information and workflows already in Curve.

“Every missed call is a patient who may not call back,” said Dave Cormack, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Curve Dental. “Practices shouldn’t have to juggle a phone vendor, a practice management system, and a stack of sticky notes to take care of the person on the line. With Curve Voice and AI Receptionist, the phone works with Curve and handles the calls staff can’t get to.”

Built for Practices That Need More From Their Phone System

Key Curve Voice capabilities include:

  • Make every call count. Built-in call analytics show call volume and answer rates, helping practices plan staffing and coverage. Calls can also route to the Curve Mobile app so dentists or on-call team members can answer after hours.
  • A more personal patient experience. When a patient calls, staff can see relevant information to tailor the conversation. Call activity, summaries, and voicemail transcriptions can be linked to the patient record, giving the team a clearer history of each interaction.
  • Stay on top of every follow-up. A call pop-up shows key details, such as the balance due and date of the last visit, helping staff quickly identify the right next step. Click-to-call from the patient record and missed-call text-back make it easier to reconnect with every caller.
  • Communicate on the go. Teams can answer practice calls and respond to texts from the Curve Mobile app, helping them stay connected to patients from anywhere without sharing personal mobile numbers.
  • Choose how your team works. Practices can use desk phones or an integrated softphone within Curve. Core phone capabilities include call routing, voicemail, ring groups, and call queues.
  • Never miss a call. An AI receptionist, available shortly after Curve Voice’s launch, will answer when the front desk is busy or the office is closed, allowing the office to respond to common questions and book routine appointments at any time.

Together, these capabilities bring phone service and practice management into one connected experience, giving teams one platform, one mobile app, and one support relationship.

What’s Next

Curve Voice is another milestone in Curve’s $200 million R&D commitment. Future development priorities include advanced call analytics designed to help practices extend coverage and surface actionable insights from patient communications.

“Curve Voice is built for Curve, by Curve, so it integrates seamlessly with the patient and practice workflows teams already use,” said Luke Anderson, Chief Product Officer at Curve Dental. “That native foundation gives us the flexibility to keep pace with customer needs. We can deepen the integration and add smarter workflows, richer insights, and new capabilities over time—reducing routine work and giving teams more time to focus on patients.”

Availability

Curve Voice is currently in closed beta, with commercial availability for Curve Dental customers expected to begin in February 2027.

To learn more, sign up for launch updates, or visit Curve Dental at Booth 2723 during the Greater New York Dental Meeting.

About Curve Dental

Curve Dental helps dental practices operate and grow through an AI-powered, cloud-native, all-in-one dental practice management platform connecting practice administration, clinical workflows, revenue cycle management, payments, and patient engagement. Its expanding capabilities and connected solutions are designed to reduce administrative work and give dental teams more time for patient care.

The privately held company serves practices across the United States and Canada, with operations in Utah, Georgia, Calgary, and Scotland. Curve Dental was named a 2026 USA TODAY Top Workplaces award winner. For more information, visit www.curvedental.com or call 1-888-910-HERO.
